forms_list_providers.description: Lists the currently registered form collection providers, their public settings fields, answer location and validation behavior. Call before selecting a provider in forms_create_definition or forms_update_definition. Read-only; unavailable settings include an explanation and must not be guessed.

queries: Which form providers can I use?
What public settings does this form provider need?

forms_list_definitions.description: Lists every form definition in the workspace with its id, name, slug, status, and field count. Read-only. Call this to find a form's opaque id from its name or slug before calling forms_update_definition, forms_set_definition_status, forms_list_submissions, or forms_get_submission — those tools take formId, not slug.

forms_create_definition.description: Creates a new form definition from a name, a URL slug, and a complete list of native field descriptors. Call forms_list_providers before selecting a public collection provider. For a dropdown, use type=select with options [{value,label}]. The slug must be unique within the workspace and can never be changed afterwards. To show this form in a post or other rich-text body, use widgets_create_instance to create a contact-form widget with config { formDefinitionId: <this form's id> }, then widgets_insert_embed it; HTML-format pages and theme templates can instead use a data-embed-config marker with {type:"form",id:<this form's id or slug>}.

name.description: Human-readable form name shown in the admin UI.

slug.description: Permanent URL slug. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; must start with a letter or digit; max 64 characters. Cannot be changed later, and must not already exist in this workspace.

id.description: Stable field id. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must start with a letter. Ids are permanent — an existing id can never be removed by an update.

label.description: Human-readable label shown above the input.

type.description: A registered native field type. Use select for a dropdown; multi-select, radio and checkbox-group require options. Phone renders type=tel, datetime renders datetime-local, toggle renders an accessible switch.

required.description: Whether the visitor must fill this field in. Must be a real boolean, not a string. Required checkbox/toggle consent must be checked.

name.description: Optional native input name; must equal id to preserve stored submission keys.

helpText.description: Accessible help shown with the field.

default.description: Initial control value, checked state, or selected option values. Must satisfy this field's rules; forbidden for files.

options.description: Required for select, multi-select, radio, checkbox-group. Values must be unique; submissions reject values outside this list.

pattern.description: Full-match text validation. Safe subset: literals, character classes, anchors and one repetition; groups, alternation and backreferences are rejected.

min.description: Numeric lower bound, or ISO native date/time lower bound.

max.description: Numeric upper bound, or ISO native date/time upper bound.

step.description: Numeric increment for number/range. Defaults to 1.

accept.description: Safe MIME types or image/*, video/*, */*. Omitted means any recognized safe file: PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/AVIF, MP4/WebM, PDF. Executables, scripts, markup and archives are always refused.

maxFileSize.description: File size limit in bytes, capped at 10 MiB. All uploads in one multipart POST must fit 12 MiB.

checkboxValue.description: Optional authored checkbox wire value; every other submitted string is rejected.

maxLength.description: Optional per-field character cap (1-5000). Only supported on text, textarea, email, phone, url and hidden fields.

className.description: Optional CSS class names applied verbatim to the rendered input element (e.g. Tailwind utility classes like 'md:col-span-2 w-1/2'). Any string is accepted — classes are escaped, not sanitized or restricted to a vocabulary.

attributes.description: Optional extra HTML attributes applied to the rendered input element. Attribute NAMES are strictly allowlisted — 'aria-*', 'data-*', 'placeholder', 'autocomplete', 'inputmode', 'pattern', 'title', 'min', 'max', 'step', 'minlength', 'spellcheck', 'readonly'. Anything else, including any 'on*' event handler, 'style', 'formaction', 'href', 'src', 'srcdoc', 'id', 'name', or 'type', is rejected — the call fails rather than silently dropping it. Values are plain strings.

fields.description: The COMPLETE field list (1-20 fields). Both tools that accept it replace the whole list, so it must include every field the form keeps — but note that unlike a content type, an EXISTING field id may never be dropped; omitting one is rejected rather than deleting it.

enabled.description: Whether to email recipients on each submission.

recipients.description: Up to 10 email addresses. Each must be a valid address or the whole call is rejected.

id.description: Collection provider id from forms_list_providers. Existing definitions and history stay local when switching.

config.description: Public string-valued settings described by forms_list_providers; never credentials or secrets.

forms_update_definition.description: Updates an existing form definition's name, field list, notification recipients, or public collection provider. Call forms_list_providers before selecting a provider and explain its answer location and validation; republish all affected static pages and Cloudflare manifests after switching. The slug is immutable and is ignored if supplied. Existing field ids cannot be dropped — omitting one is rejected, not treated as a deletion. Pass expectedVersion from content_read.form_definition; if someone changed it since, nothing is saved and you must re-read.

formId.description: The form definition's id, as returned by a create call. This is the opaque id, NOT the slug.

expectedVersion.description: The record's version from content_read.form_definition. Required.

name.description: New form name. Omit to leave unchanged.

forms_set_definition_status.description: Sets a form definition's status to 'active' or 'disabled'. Disabling is how a form is taken out of service without deleting it — no tool in this catalog can delete a form definition; permanent deletion happens only through the Trash.

formId.description: The form definition's id, as returned by a create call. This is the opaque id, NOT the slug.

status.description: 'disabled' takes the form out of service (its stored submissions are retained); 'active' puts it back.

forms_list_submissions.description: Lists a form's submissions, newest-first, with each submission's field values, source IP, and submission time. Read-only. To remove a submission, move it to the Trash with trash_item (entityType 'form_submission'); permanent removal stays human-only, from the Trash screen.

formId.description: The form definition's id, as returned by a create call. This is the opaque id, NOT the slug.

limit.description: Page size, 1-100. Defaults to 50 if omitted.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

forms_delivery_status.description: Shows whether form submissions reached the destinations configured to receive them (the site's form delivery bindings): per binding, its status (pending, retrying, completed or failed), attempts so far, the next retry time and a short error code. With submissionId, that submission's deliveries; without it, the most recent deliveries that have not completed. Read-only; never shows answers, destination addresses or credentials.

submissionId.description: The submission's id, as returned by forms_list_submissions.

limit.description: Without submissionId: how many unfinished deliveries to list, 1-50. Defaults to 50.

forms_pull_submissions.description: Brings form submissions that a static export stored at its hosting provider back into Submissions here, checks them with the form's own rules, and sends the usual new-submission notifications. Only rows saved here are cleared at the host, so pulling again is always safe and never duplicates. Use it when the owner asks for new entries from a static export. Returns a plain summary per hosting target, counts per form (formId, formSlug, imported, alreadyImported, unmapped, failed) with totals, and ran: false with reason 'already-running' when another pull of the same host is still in progress.

targetId.description: Optional hosting target id to pull from that target only. Omit to pull from every hosting target that receives forms.
